messages:
emily.supp: Hey team — customer AcmeWidgets opened a billing dispute. Invoice shows ~1.2M embedding units for March, dashboard shows ~420k. They uploaded a CSV via S3 manifest and used the bulk embeddings job. Can we triage?
raj.billing: Thanks Emily. Do we have invoice line items and the job id? Any account id?
emily.supp: Customer account: acme-widgets (acct_54321). Invoice lines attached (snippet):
```
2026-03-31 | embeddings.bulk | 1,200,432 units | $240.09
```
Job id from UI: bulk-emb-20260328-7f3a

sophia.eng-ml: Quick question — are they using rerank after embedding or just vector store? Rerank pairwise can explode counts.
emily.supp: They said rerank for a subset, but bulk upload should be embeddings-only. Their support ticket says rerank was a separate API call for another flow.
dave.runtime: I'll pull the ingest logs for bulk-emb-20260328-7f3a. ingest-bot: fetched manifest s3://acme-prod/manifests/2026-03-28.csv, items=295k, max_text_len=~6k chars.
sophia.eng-ml: 295k inputs * pairwise would be huge, but that doesn't match 1.2M vs 420k. That delta is ~3x. Could be batch splitting + retries double-counting some items.
emily.supp: Customer included a sample of 3 rows that were charged as 9 embedding units on invoice (they expected 3). They also provided a CSV fragment.
raj.billing: Can you repro locally? If it's double-counting we may need to issue a credit.
sophia.eng-ml: Repro plan: run our bulk ingest emulator with their CSV chunk + manifest and instrument per-record accounting. Use the same batching (batch_size=512), and simulate intermittent 503 to trigger worker retry.
dave.runtime: Sharing quick repro curl for the bulk job API we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/bulk/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"manifest_url":"s3://acme-prod/manifests/2026-03-28.csv","batch_size":512,"async":true}'
```
This starts job bulk-emb-XXXX and workers chunk the manifest into tasks.
sophia.eng-ml: Ran repro with injected 503 at random task completion. Observed that when a task fails after uploading to queue but before ack, the worker re-enqueues the same chunk without an idempotency key and downstream billing counted the chunk twice. Logging excerpt: `task_id=chunk-129 status=completed billing_counted=true` then on retry `task_id=chunk-129 status=completed billing_counted=true` (two separate events).
dave.runtime: Root cause looks like our bulk pipeline emits billing events on downstream success but doesn't dedupe by chunk_id for async flows. Synchronous API paths set an idempotency token; async S3-manifest flow did not.
emily.supp: Can we confirm dimensions? Customer also mentioned some 1024-d vectors in invoice but they expect 768.
sophia.eng-ml: Checked model profile used in bulk job: model=embed-lite-768 (dims=768). The pipeline did not transform dims. The 1024 mention in their support attachments was from a separate rerank experiment they ran on a different job id. Separate noise.
raj.billing: OK if duplicate chunk replays explain ~2x? But invoice delta is ~3x (1.2M vs 420k).
sophia.eng-ml: Found additional factor: their manifest had ~295k rows, but some rows contained duplicated records (due to client-side dedupe bug) and we also retried 2 chunks twice in same window — combination yields ~3x. In short: (original rows ~140k deduped on client?) + duplicate uploads + retry doubles -> ~1.2M accounting. I can produce a breakdown per-chunk.
emily.supp: Customer asked for exact per-job line reconciliation for audit — can we produce CSV: chunk_id, input_count, billed_count, attempts?
dave.runtime: Yes. I'm generating a reconciliation export now. Example row: `chunk-129,512,1024,2` meaning billed twice. Will attach shortly.
(ingest-bot uploaded /recon/bulk-emb-20260328-recon.csv)

emily.supp: Attached file shows ~48k billed-duplicates across chunks (~480k extra units) + ~300k duplicates from manifest bad dedupe -> aligns with invoice gap.
raj.billing: Thanks. Next steps: 1) issue full credit for duplicated billed units (estimate $........), 2) fix pipeline to include chunk_id idempotency at billing emission, 3) notify customer and close.
sophia.eng-ml: I'll open an internal PR to add dedupe keys in the async worker and add a check in billing-ingest to ignore repeated billing events within 24h for same chunk_id/job_id.
dave.runtime: Deploying hotfix to staging for the worker today; will promote to prod after smoke tests.
emily.supp: Customer asked for ETA on credit and fix. Raj, can billing issue interim credit and then final reconcile after prod fix?
raj.billing: We'll issue a provisional credit on acct_54321 today and include full audit CSV. Final adjustment after prod confirm.
emily.supp: Customer replied: "Thanks — appreciate the quick triage. We'll hold on further rerank runs until you confirm." :thumbsup: 
sophia.eng-ml: One more note — adding a best-effort validation step on upload that checks for duplicate content hashes in the manifest would have caught their client-side duplication earlier. I'll propose that in the PR.
emily.supp: Closing loop — will update ticket with credits + attached reconciliation CSV once Raj confirms. Marking thread resolved for support. :white_check_mark:
